extract_grid_features: run grid feature extraction on a COCO dataset using a Detectron2 model and config file
setup_detectron2_config: create and configure a Detectron2 config with attribute support and RES5 dilation settings
build_argument_parser: build an argparse parser for grid feature extraction with config file and dataset options
extract_features_on_dataset: extract RoI conv5 features from a model backbone and save them as pth files
resume_model_weights: resume or load Detectron2 model weights from a checkpoint before feature extraction
